title: How OpenAI Used Its Own LLMs to Design Its Jalapeño Chip
summary: OpenAI reportedly leveraged its own large language models to assist in the design of a custom chip codenamed Jalapeño, applying AI to hardware engineering tasks such as architecture exploration and optimization. The article, discussed on Lobste.rs, highlights a self-reinforcing loop where OpenAI's LLMs aid in creating specialized silicon, potentially improving training and inference efficiency for future models.
